title: Step 2 - Using preProcess Function in R for PCA: Extracting Principal Components

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So in this tutorial, we are going to apply PCA.
cues.zh: 這堂課要套用 PCA。

cues.en: And actually I've prepared you the required package to apply this first dimensionality reduction technique, principal component analysis.
cues.zh: 我已準備好套用第一種降維技術，主成分分析，所需的套件。

cues.en: So these packages are caret, which I think we already installed, but if that's not the case, then you can check it here in packages.
cues.zh: 套件包括 caret，我想先前已經安裝；如果沒有，可以到 Packages 檢查。

cues.en: You can see if you have caret available in this list of packages.
cues.zh: 看看套件清單裡是否有 caret。

cues.en: If you don't see it here, you can execute this line without a comment and this will install caret.
cues.zh: 找不到的話，就移除這一行的註解並執行，安裝 caret。

cues.en: So that's the first package.
cues.zh: 這是第一個套件。

cues.en: Then this is to actually import this caret package.
cues.zh: 接著這行實際載入 caret 套件。

cues.en: So we'll execute that as well.
cues.zh: 所以也會執行它。

cues.en: And we also need this other package that we installed in part three, classification, the e1071 package.
cues.zh: 還需要第三部分分類時裝過的 e1071 套件。

cues.en: So normally you should have it installed, but if that's not the case, you can select this line and install the package.
cues.zh: 通常應該已安裝，否則可選取這行安裝。

cues.en: And don't forget to execute this line as well to select it.
cues.zh: 別忘記也執行這行來載入它。

cues.en: And now we are ready to start applying PCA.
cues.zh: 現在可以開始套用 PCA。

cues.en: So the first thing that we're gonna do is create a new variable that we're gonna call pca, that we will use afterwards to transform our original data set, composed of our 13 features,
cues.zh: 首先建立新變數，命名為 pca，稍後用來將原本包含 13 個特徵的資料集，

cues.en: into this new data set with the new extracted features.
cues.zh: 轉換為包含新擷取特徵的資料集。

cues.en: So, now, to create this object, we're gonna use a function.
cues.zh: 要建立這個物件，會使用一個函式。

cues.en: This is the preProcess function.
cues.zh: 就是 preProcess。

cues.en: Here it is, from the caret package.
cues.zh: 在這裡，來自 caret 套件。

cues.en: And let's now press F1 here to see all the info of this preProcess function, because you're gonna see that you have some very useful parameters that allow you to apply PCA according to your goals.
cues.zh: 按 F1 查看 preProcess 的資訊，你會看到一些很有用的參數，能依目標套用 PCA。

cues.en: For example, you can specify the minimum ratio of explained variance you want to get.
cues.zh: 例如，可以指定希望得到的最低解釋變異比例。

cues.en: That means, for example, if you want to reduce the dimensionality of your data set down to a number of features that will explain at least 60% of the variance, well, you can specify this with one of the parameters
cues.zh: 假設希望降維後的特徵數量，至少能解釋 60% 的變異，就能透過這個

cues.en: of this preProcess function.
cues.zh: preProcess 函式的參數指定。

cues.en: So let's have a look at the info.
cues.zh: 來看看說明。

cues.en: That's the info and let's jump to the arguments.
cues.zh: 這是說明，直接到 Arguments。

cues.en: So right, the first argument is x, a matrix or data frame.
cues.zh: 第一個參數是 x，矩陣或資料框。

cues.en: This is actually the data of which we want to reduce the dimensionality.
cues.zh: 就是想降低維度的資料。

cues.en: So this is going to be our training set.
cues.zh: 因此是訓練集。

cues.en: So x will be the training set.
cues.zh: x 會是 training_set。

cues.en: Then the next argument is method.
cues.zh: 下一個參數是 method。

cues.en: So method is your dimensionality-reduction technique.
cues.zh: method 就是使用的降維技術。

cues.en: So as you can see, you have several techniques of dimensionality reduction, pca, ica.
cues.zh: 可以看到有多種技術，例如 pca、ica。

cues.en: So these are other methods, but of course the one that we want to use is pca, principal component analysis.
cues.zh: 這些是不同方法，當然我們要用的是 pca，主成分分析。

cues.en: So we'll use method=pca here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡使用 method = 'pca'。

cues.en: Then thresh, thresh is a very important parameter.
cues.zh: 接著 thresh，是非常重要的參數。

cues.en: That's what I've just told you.
cues.zh: 就是剛才提到的。

cues.en: If you want to reduce your dimensionality of your data set with at least a minimum amount of explained variance, well, you can do it by using this thresh parameter.
cues.zh: 想降維，同時保留至少一定程度的解釋變異，就能用 thresh 指定。

cues.en: And as you can see, it's a cutoff of the cumulative percent of variance to be retained by PCA.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它是 PCA 保留累積變異百分比的門檻。

cues.en: So, for example, if you want your new extracted features to explain at least 60% of the variance, well, you need to specify here thresh=0.6, 60%.
cues.zh: 例如想讓新擷取的特徵至少解釋 60% 的變異，就指定 thresh = 0.6，也就是 60%。

cues.en: But we're not gonna use this thresh parameter here because we already know what we want.
cues.zh: 但這裡不使用 thresh，因為已經知道想要什麼。

cues.en: What we want is two independent variables because we want to be able to visualize the training set results and the test set results and that we will be able to get with the next parameter,
cues.zh: 我們要兩個自變數，才能將訓練集與測試集結果視覺化。這可透過下一個參數，

cues.en: pcaComp, that is, the specific number of PCA components to keep.
cues.zh: pcaComp，也就是指定保留的 PCA 成分數量。

cues.en: So that's exactly the number of extracted features you want to obtain in the end.
cues.zh: 它正是最後要取得的擷取特徵數量。

cues.en: So here we will input pcaComp=2, so that our training set, our original training set, will go from having 13 independent variables,
cues.zh: 所以輸入 pcaComp = 2，讓原始訓練集從 13 個自變數，

cues.en: the 13 original independent variables that we had in our data set, to having two new extracted features that will explain the most the variance.
cues.zh: 也就是原本資料集的 13 個自變數，變成最能解釋變異的兩個新擷取特徵。

cues.en: And as you can see, if we specify this pcaComp parameter, this overrides thresh.
cues.zh: 可以看到，如果指定 pcaComp，就會覆蓋 thresh。

cues.en: So that's why we don't need to specify this thresh parameter to specify a minimum cumulative percent of explained variance.
cues.zh: 所以不需要再用 thresh 指定最低累積解釋變異比例。

cues.en: Alright, and then you have other parameters, but we won't use them.
cues.zh: 還有其他參數，但這裡不使用。

cues.en: We actually only need our x, to specify the data we want to transform, to extract the new features, the method, pca, and the number of extracted features
cues.zh: 只需要 x，指定要轉換、擷取新特徵的資料；method 設 pca；以及最後希望得到的

cues.en: we want to get eventually, that is two new extracted features.
cues.zh: 擷取特徵數量，也就是兩個。

cues.en: So let's input the arguments.
cues.zh: 來輸入參數。

cues.en: Let's start with the first one x=, so that's training set.
cues.zh: 第一個 x = training_set。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: And actually we need to specify the features, and actually that's not the whole training set because, remember, PCA is an unsupervised dimensionality-reduction technique.
cues.zh: 但實際上要指定特徵，不能用整個訓練集，因為記得 PCA 是非監督式降維技術。

cues.en: That means, that we don't consider the dependent variable to extract the new features.
cues.zh: 也就是擷取新特徵時，不考慮依變數。

cues.en: So we actually need to remove here the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 所以必須排除依變數。

cues.en: And remember this has index 14, so the way we can do that is the same as we did for feature scaling.
cues.zh: 記得它的索引是 14，做法和特徵縮放相同。

cues.en: That means we just add here minus 14.
cues.zh: 只要在這裡加上 -14。

cues.en: All right, so now PCA will be applied on all the features, the 13 features of our training set.
cues.zh: 現在 PCA 就會套用到訓練集的全部 13 個特徵。

cues.en: Perfect, now next argument.
cues.zh: 很好，下一個參數。

cues.en: Next argument is method, and as we said, method equals, in quotes, pca.
cues.zh: 是 method，如前所述，等於引號裡的 pca。

cues.en: All right, then comma, next argument, and last argument, and as we said, that's pcaComp.
cues.zh: 加逗號，下一個、也是最後一個參數，如剛才所說，是 pcaComp。

cues.en: So pca and what we want is two new extracted features.
cues.zh: 我們希望得到兩個新擷取特徵。

cues.en: All right, so that creates the PCA object that we will then use on our training set to transform our original training set composed of our 13 independent variables
cues.zh: 這就建立了 pca 物件，稍後用它將原本包含 13 個自變數的訓練集，

cues.en: to this new training set of reduced dimensionality and that will contain the two new extracted features that will explain the most variance.
cues.zh: 轉換為較低維的新訓練集，包含最能解釋變異的兩個新擷取特徵。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's take our training set, because we are gonna call this new training set, training set as well, because, you know, then we have all our templates, and we use this training set variable name.
cues.zh: 使用 training_set，新訓練集仍叫 training_set，因為後面的範本都使用這個變數名稱。

cues.en: So we want to keep this training set name.
cues.zh: 所以保留 training_set 這個名稱。

cues.en: But of course, if you want to keep your original training set and test set, you can use other names, like trainingset_pca.
cues.zh: 當然，若想保留原始訓練集與測試集，可以改用其他名稱，例如 training_set_pca。

cues.en: But then if you do that, don't forget to change training set here by trainingset_pca, and here testset_pca as well.
cues.zh: 但這麼做，別忘記把後面這裡的 training_set 換成 training_set_pca，test_set 也換成 test_set_pca。

cues.en: And the same for the confusion matrix section, and especially here, visualizing the training set result.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣區段也是，尤其這裡的訓練集結果視覺化。

cues.en: You will need to replace training set here by trainingset_pca.
cues.zh: 需要把 training_set 換成 training_set_pca。

cues.en: All right, so that's why we are keeping the name.
cues.zh: 這就是保留原名稱的原因。

cues.en: It's in order not to have to change everything.
cues.zh: 避免到處都要修改。

cues.en: So let's go back to training set equals, and now let's transform this original training set into our new training set composed of our new extracted features.
cues.zh: 回到 training_set 等於，現在把原始訓練集，轉成包含新擷取特徵的新訓練集。

cues.en: And to do this is very simple.
cues.zh: 做法非常簡單。

cues.en: We use the predict function and inside we take our PCA object, comma, and we apply this PCA transformation object
cues.zh: 使用 predict 函式，裡面先放 pca 物件，再加逗號，將這個 PCA 轉換物件

cues.en: on the original training set that is named trainingset, as well.
cues.zh: 套用到同樣名為 training_set 的原始訓練集。

cues.en: And so by doing this, this original training set will become this new training set composed of the two new extracted features.
cues.zh: 如此一來，原始訓練集就會變成包含兩個新擷取特徵的新訓練集。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Let's start by creating this object, and then we will transform our training set.
cues.zh: 先建立這個物件，再轉換訓練集。

cues.en: So I'm going to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行並執行。

cues.en: Perfect, the PCA object is ready to be used on the original training set to transform it into our new training set
cues.zh: 很好，pca 物件準備好了，可以用在原始訓練集，轉換成

cues.en: composed of the two new extracted features.
cues.zh: 包含兩個新擷取特徵的新訓練集。

cues.en: So let's execute this as well.
cues.zh: 這行也執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Our new training set is now created.
cues.zh: 新的訓練集已建立。

cues.en: We can have a look, as you can see when I'm clicking on this.
cues.zh: 可以點開看看。

cues.en: Well, I have a new training set composed of two new extracted features.
cues.zh: 現在的新訓練集，包含兩個新擷取特徵。

cues.en: And remember these two new extracted features are called the principal components.
cues.zh: 記得，這兩個特徵叫做主成分。

cues.en: So that's why you have PC1 and PC2.
cues.zh: 所以名稱是 PC1 與 PC2。

cues.en: And of course we still have our dependent variable vector, the customer segment dependent variable, with its three labels, one, two, and three.
cues.zh: 當然也保留依變數向量 Customer_Segment，以及三個標籤 1、2、3。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: But now, as you can clearly notice, the dependent variable vector just went in first position.
cues.zh: 但你可以清楚注意到，依變數向量跑到第一個位置。

cues.en: And since then we're gonna use the template on data sets, I mean the training set and the test set where the dependent variable is in last position, we will need to put this dependent variable
cues.zh: 接下來的範本，預期訓練集與測試集的依變數在最後，所以需要把依變數

cues.en: in last position here, and that's actually very easy.
cues.zh: 放到最後，這非常容易。

cues.en: What we only need to do is play with the indexes to put this customer segment dependent variable in last position.
cues.zh: 只需要運用索引，把 Customer_Segment 依變數放到最後。

cues.en: So the method is really easy.
cues.zh: 方法很簡單。

cues.en: We're gonna take our training set again, here we go, and then equals.
cues.zh: 再次使用 training_set，再加等號。

cues.en: And then we take again our training set, then brackets, and then inside these brackets, we're gonna take the indexes of the columns of our training set in the correct order we want to get.
cues.zh: 右邊再次寫 training_set，加上中括號，在裡面按希望的正確順序，放入欄位索引。

cues.en: So you're gonna understand that now, we're gonna take a vector.
cues.zh: 現在就會明白，會使用一個向量。

cues.en: So remember in R, vector is taken with c and then parentheses.
cues.zh: 記得 R 的向量使用 c，再加括號。

cues.en: All right, and inside these parentheses, we put the correct order of the indexes we want to get.
cues.zh: 在括號裡，輸入想要的索引正確順序。

cues.en: So let's go back to our training set.
cues.zh: 回到訓練集。

cues.en: The first column we want to get is PC1.
cues.zh: 希望第一欄是 PC1。

cues.en: That should be the first column of our new training set.
cues.zh: 它應成為新訓練集的第一欄。

cues.en: And this has index two.
cues.zh: 目前它的索引是 2。

cues.en: So here we input the first index, which is two, then comma, and then we input the second index we want to get, that is the second column.
cues.zh: 所以先輸入第一個索引 2，再加逗號，輸入希望的第二欄索引。

cues.en: And the second column is PC2, and this has index three.
cues.zh: 第二欄是 PC2，目前索引是 3。

cues.en: So here we input three.
cues.zh: 所以輸入 3。

cues.en: And then here you input the index of the last column you want to have in your training set.
cues.zh: 接著輸入希望作為訓練集最後一欄的索引。

cues.en: And the last column you want to have in your training set is this customer segment column, because that's the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 最後一欄希望是 Customer_Segment，因為它是依變數。

cues.en: And so far, this customer segment has index one.
cues.zh: 目前 Customer_Segment 的索引是 1。

cues.en: So you need to specify here this index that is one.
cues.zh: 所以這裡指定索引 1。

cues.en: And by doing this, our new training set here will be the same training set that we have here, but with a new order of the columns.
cues.zh: 這樣新訓練集和目前資料相同，只是欄位順序不同。

cues.en: And that is given by this order here.
cues.zh: 順序由這裡指定。

cues.en: First, the first independent variable that has index two, then the second independent variable that has index three, and eventually the dependent variable column that has index one.
cues.zh: 先是索引 2 的第一個自變數，再是索引 3 的第二個自變數，最後是索引 1 的依變數欄。

cues.en: You're gonna see if I select this line now and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行並執行，就會看到。

cues.en: And if I go back to training set, now I have my first two columns as the new extracted features, PC1 and PC2, and the last column customer segment in last position,
cues.zh: 回到 training_set，現在前兩欄是新擷取特徵 PC1、PC2，最後一欄是 Customer_Segment，

cues.en: as our code templates that we're gonna use is expecting it.
cues.zh: 正好符合接下來程式碼範本的要求。

cues.en: So that's perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: We can go back to PCA.
cues.zh: 回到 PCA。

cues.en: And now we need to do the same for the test set.
cues.zh: 現在測試集也要做相同處理。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do is select these two lines, copy them, and just replace training set here by test set.
cues.zh: 選取這兩行、複製，把 training_set 換成 test_set。

cues.en: Same here, test set, and same here as well, test set, and eventually test set.
cues.zh: 這裡換成 test_set，這裡也是，最後這裡也換成 test_set。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that's, of course, the same indexes for the order you want to have.
cues.zh: 希望的欄位順序，當然使用同樣索引。

cues.en: We can check it out.
cues.zh: 可以確認一下。

cues.en: I'm going to select this line.
cues.zh: 選取這行。

cues.en: As you can see so far, the test set has its 13 original features.
cues.zh: 目前 test_set 仍有原始 13 個特徵。

cues.en: Then if I execute this line, it now has two new extracted features, the principal components one and two, but the customer segment is in first position.
cues.zh: 執行後，就有兩個新擷取特徵，第一、第二主成分，但 Customer_Segment 在第一個位置。

cues.en: We want to put it in the last position.
cues.zh: 要把它放到最後。

cues.en: And so to do this, we execute this line and that will do it.
cues.zh: 所以執行這一行，就能完成。

cues.en: If I go back to test set, now the customer segment is in last position, and we are ready to use the following parts of the template, predict the test set results, make the confusion matrix,
cues.zh: 回到 test_set，Customer_Segment 已在最後，現在可以使用後續範本，預測測試集結果、建立混淆矩陣，

cues.en: and eventually, that's the most exciting part, we will now be able to visualize the training set results because we now have two dimensions in our training set and test sets.
cues.zh: 最後是最令人期待的部分，將訓練集結果視覺化，因為現在訓練集與測試集都只有兩維。

cues.en: So I look forward to visualizing these results in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂課一起呈現結果。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning!
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧！
